capabilities: Browse and select notes in a searchable folder tree
Resolve and copy attachments referenced by embeds and links
Recreate the source folder structure in the destination vault
Pick a destination vault with a folder picker
Persist destination and option defaults between sessions
disambiguation: It copies notes to another vault; it does not keep vaults in sync or move notes between vaults.
extras: README warns to back up vaults before use, states the plugin is desktop-only (not compatible with Obsidian Mobile), and the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to copy notes together with their referenced attachments into a different vault.
summary: Copies selected notes and their embedded attachments from the current vault to another vault, optionally preserving the folder hierarchy.
